column1: # Star materials (research round 17, addendum 2; First hours, 11-05; Ronald: "Yes, as designed"): the big impact's iron core in broken rock, pallasite (olivine in nickel-iron), and a lantern holding a Starheart (its _e made in code). BLOCK_LIKE: meteorite,suevite,golden_lamp,diamond_block

column3: star_steel_ore|cube|Star steel ore: the iron core of a big impact in broken grey impact rock, seamless: several heavy dark nickel-iron masses 6-10 px across (#2e3036 #44474e #5e626a #7c8088) with a bright metallic sheen on their lit edges (#a8b0ba #ccd4dc) and a faint fine etched crosshatch of thin lighter lines on their faces (the Widmanstatten pattern), set in broken grey rock (#5a5e5c #747876 #8e9290) with dark cracks, heavier and more metallic than an ore, light from the top left
column4: pallasite|cube|Pallasite, a stunning decor block, seamless: rounded and angular translucent olive-green olivine crystals 4-8 px (#3e5a1c #5c7e26 #84a63a #b0cc5a with a pale #d8ec90 glint on each) set close together in a bright polished nickel-iron matrix (#8a9098 #aab0b8 #cdd2d8) that shows between them as a silvery web, the gems looking glassy with a darker rim and a light inner face, light from the top left
column5: star_lantern|framed|Star lantern block, a lantern holding a Starheart: a dark blackened iron frame (#24262c #383b44 #4e525c) with corner rivets around four panes of clear glass, behind them a small glowing faceted crystal in the middle giving a cool blue-white light (#9fc4ff #cfe2ff #f2f8ff, a near-white core), a soft pale blue glow filling the panes around it, no flame, light from the top left

column1: # Loose tektite (First hours, 11-05): the material of a few small shard boxes lying round a crater, like loose_flint's flint_nodule. BLOCK_LIKE: flint_nodule,impact_glass

column3: loose_tektite|cube|Tektite glass as a block tile for small shard boxes, seamless: translucent-looking bottle-green natural glass (#1e3a1e #2e5a2c #487a3c #6a9c50) with a sculpted, pitted, wrinkled surface of little grooves and round hollows 2-4 px, each hollow with a darker rim and a lighter inner edge, a few pale green glints (#a8d488), no other colours, light from the top left
